survey_probe.name: Survey Probe
survey_probe.job: Orbits a world and reads it in layers: orbit, air, surface, crust, biosign, ruins, legal title.

harvest_drone.name: Harvest Drone
harvest_drone.job: Spends time on a scanned node, then brings raw mass back to the hold.

salvage_tender.name: Salvage Tender
salvage_tender.job: Strips a wreck for keel salvage and one crate. Wreck rights, not a looting festival.

away_shuttle.name: Away Shuttle
away_shuttle.job: Puts a crew on the marked pocket. A closed mark stays closed.

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.job: A small ship bought at the pad. It holds a station on the wing, follows the keel, and attacks the locked target.

dart_drone.name: Dart
dart_drone.job: Level 1 interceptor. A thin chase drone that runs the locked ship down and cuts across the bow.

sting_drone.name: Sting
sting_drone.job: Level 1 gunner. A stubby volume drone that sits on the beam and throws a lot of light shot.

wasp_drone.name: Wasp
wasp_drone.job: Level 2 striker. The pad's mid-weight attack drone. It forms, follows, and hits the lock.

fang_drone.name: Fang
fang_drone.job: Level 2 hunter. A long-nose drone that holds range and picks at a marked ship.

lance_drone.name: Lance
lance_drone.job: Level 3 heavy. A slow iron drone with a punch that belongs on a locked hull, not a chase.

livestock_lighter.name: Livestock Lighter
livestock_lighter.job: Moves a hold-kine between the keel and a claim pen. It is a barn with an engine.
